test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Consider the given statement and decide which of the given assumptions is/are implicit in the statement.

Statement:

Examinations must be conducted without any favours to evaluate the true performance of the students.

Assumptions:

1. No unfair means or help shall be provided to the students.

2. Teachers should help their favourite students perform better.
solution:
The statement suggests that exams must happen without any bias.

 
• Assumption 1 agrees with it and promotes that unfair means should not be allowed so that students are evaluated fairly. 
 
• Assumption 2 talks against the given statement and promotes bias towards favourite students. So, assumption 2 is not implicit.
 
• The words "without any favours" implies that assumption 1 is implicit but assumption 2 is not.

Hence the correct answer is **option 2**.
